what_they_do: Tandem sits on top of the CAD and PLM stack hardware teams already run and keeps one live record of design intent, requirements, CAD changes and review decisions. It turns work happening inside CAD sessions into the engineering paperwork teams assemble by hand today: change order drafts, design review packets, change impact analyses and traceability records. It replaces the manual reconstruction of why a part changed and what else that change touches, which currently lives in spreadsheets, email threads and individual engineers' memory.
vertical: hardware engineering teams in regulated and high-consequence product categories
theme_fit_rationale: Tandem holds one workflow together across CAD, PLM, Slack, Teams and Excel, systems never designed to reconcile with each other, and the connective record it accumulates is what turns it into a system of record over time. Secondary fit to theme 8 because much of the captured context is review and decision conversation.

market: hardware engineering workflow software, PLM and CAD adjacent engineering systems of record

market_patterns.pattern: The products that land in engineering orgs sit beside the existing system of record and automate one painful repeated step inside the engineer's own workflow, handing output back into whatever the team already uses. Adoption comes from being native to the domain rather than from being a better general-purpose tool.
market_patterns.failure_mode: The ones that stall ask the team to migrate the system of record before the product can prove anything. A prior migration that went badly leaves durable wariness, and that memory, not the feature comparison, is usually what kills the deal.

market_patterns.pattern: Pilots convert when the buyer can watch the product run on their own drawings and their own data and see a before-and-after inside the evaluation itself, with the daily practitioner validating usability and the business owner validating output quality before anything goes to procurement.
market_patterns.failure_mode: The ones that stall lead with a polished demo on vendor data and leave the accuracy question open, so the evaluation turns into an unbounded review exercise instead of a decision.

market_patterns.pattern: Accounts expand outward from the point solution into the integration layer, and the product becomes hard to displace at the moment it starts holding the links between artifacts that previously lived in separate systems. That connective record, not the original feature, is what makes it permanent.
market_patterns.failure_mode: The ones that stall stay adjacent to the operating workflow, so the team quietly keeps its old coordination tool running alongside and the new product never becomes the place people look first.
